SL1A SITE INFO: SL1A is located on an offshoot of the Tanana River (from Arctic Health Building to warehouse/boat to river to site was 1.5-2 hours, so plan for about 3-4 hours of time to get to site). There is some pink on the riverbend that marks where the boardwalks start. After passing boardwalks there is a creek crossing (Sevenmile Slough on GIS) where more pink flagging will mark your way to the plot. The plot stakes are fiber glass and have no tags, so they need to be retagged/put in with new metal stakes. Some Picea trees were too small to identify, or were difficult to characterize at a young age, so we just characterized them as PICEA, and should be confirmed as PICGLA or PICMAR for the next inventory.
